name: Add Task
description: The user creates a new task by opening the Task Form from the Task List and providing a title, optional due date, and status. Once saved, the new task appears in the list.
preconditions: The Task List screen is visible

main_flow.description: Opens the Task Form modal in create mode with empty fields and default status 'Todo'
Enters a task title and optionally a due date and status
Saves the new task and adds it to the task list
Closes the modal and shows a success notification

alternative_flows.name: Missing title
alternative_flows.trigger: At step 4, the user submits without a title, or with only whitespace
steps: System displays a validation error under the Title field

alternative_flows.name: User cancels
alternative_flows.trigger: At step 3, the user clicks Cancel or closes the modal

postconditions: The new task is saved and visible in the task list
business_rules: A title consisting only of whitespace is treated as missing
Status defaults to 'Todo' for new tasks

bdd_scenarios.given: The user is on the Task List screen
bdd_scenarios.when: The user clicks Add Task, enters a title, and saves
bdd_scenarios.then: The new task appears in the task list and a success notification is shown

bdd_scenarios.given: The user has opened the Task Form in create mode
bdd_scenarios.when: The user tries to save without entering a title
bdd_scenarios.then: A validation error is shown under the Title field and the task is not saved

bdd_scenarios.given: The user has opened the Task Form in create mode
bdd_scenarios.when: The user clicks Cancel or closes the modal
bdd_scenarios.then: The modal closes and no task is created

bdd_scenarios.scenario: Add Task — whitespace-only title treated as missing
bdd_scenarios.given: The Task List screen is visible
bdd_scenarios.when: The user enters a title consisting only of whitespace and attempts to save
bdd_scenarios.then: The system treats the title as missing, displays a validation error under the Title field, and the task is not saved
